title: Contact us
description: The Study Advisory Service is always available for information on the Master in History and Theory of Art and Architecture. Call us or send us an email today.

blocks.html:
The Study Advisory Service is available for study orientation meetings and general information about the University.

The service offers the following contact methods and schedules:

  • Desk (Via Buffi 13, Lugano, office 320): Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM and from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM
  • Phone +41 58 666 4795: available in the morning from Tuesday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM, and in the afternoon on Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday from 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM.
  • Personalized consultations by appointment, available in person or remotely via Microsoft Teams, can be booked on this webpage.

For general inquiries, you can fill out the form:

Contact us

For information about the academic programme of the Master in history and Theory of Art and Architecture please contact:
